title: Prepaid Unit Grants, Rollover, Expiry and Top-Ups on the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan
content:
Every CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan keeps a balance of prepaid calibration units. The balance increases with annual allotments, rollovers and purchased top-ups, and decreases with calibrations performed against the plan and with year-end expiry.

## Rules

1. **Grant.** At the start of each plan year the plan is granted the tier's prepaid units per plan year plus the rollover from the year before. The grant is dated the first day of the plan year and carries a plan year reference (CPY-...).
2. **One grant per plan year.** Each plan receives at most one unit grant for a plan year. This is read from the plan's own unit records: a grant already booked for the same plan under the same plan year reference means no further grant for that plan year.
3. **Year end.** At the plan year end the tier's rollover percent of the unused units, rounded down to whole units, roll into the next year if the plan renews, and where the tier's year-end expiry setting is on the rest expire; nothing rolls into a lapsed or cancelled plan.
4. **Unused units.** The unused units are the plan's prepaid unit balance on the last day of the plan year: units granted plus units purchased, less units consumed and units expired.
5. **Top-ups.** A top-up of at least the tier's smallest top-up may be bought at the tier's top-up price per unit on a tier whose top-up price is above 0.00; purchased units expire with the plan year like granted units. A top-up is booked with a top-up reference (CTU-...), the units bought and the price paid, and is billed as a unit top-up charge.

## Year-end worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unused units on the last day of the plan year | 45 |
| Rollover percent of the tier | 10 |
| 10 percent of 45 | 4.5 |
| Units rolling over, rounded down to whole units | 4 |
| Units expiring (expiry setting on) | 41 |
| Allotment of the tier for the new plan year | 30 |
| Grant at the start of the new plan year, if the plan renews | 34 |

If the same plan does not renew and lapses, nothing rolls into it.

## Points of judgement

- *Rollover at 0 percent:* no unit carries forward; with the expiry setting on, every unused unit expires at the plan year end.
- *Purchased units:* a top-up bought during the year is part of the same balance and expires with the plan year like granted units.
- *Top-up below the smallest purchase:* a top-up must be of at least the tier's smallest top-up in units (hypothetically, a tier with a smallest top-up of 10 units does not sell a top-up of 8 units).
- *Tier without top-ups:* a tier whose top-up price is 0.00 does not offer top-ups.
